scope: Owner-requested optional current-configuration backup for both restore and factory reset; shared Chinese filename defaults.
authorization: The owner explicitly chose to replace mandatory reset backup with two user-selected execution buttons. This overrides the previous software-only mandatory-backup restriction; all native commands and capability/identity checks are retained.
behavior: Both operations offer direct execution and execution after backup.
Factory reset still requires its risk checkbox for either button.
Backup destination is requested only after the backup choice; cancelling that picker stops the action.
Archive identity/hash validation, source-file protection, configuration-token rechecks and backup-failure stop conditions remain in place.
Default local names are configuration backup or execution-before-operation backup in Chinese, with date/time and .tar.gz. Policy actions use the same filename helper.
Unicode local archive names are copied into a bounded ASCII temporary archive before restore upload; local names do not enter sysupgrade command arguments.

new_cases: Cancelled backup destination does not execute
Unicode export-inspect-restore round trip with ASCII remote path

platform_boundary: Same Python/Qt flow on Windows and Debian; native file dialog behavior and Unicode filesystem paths still need Debian desktop acceptance. No new remote command or package/driver rule was introduced.
pending_separate_task: Package-cancellation lifecycle patch remains review-only after automatic approval rejection; it has not been applied or executed.

followup_review.finding: Reproduced: Return on the focused Direct button activated the backup primary button instead. Space and mouse clicks used the correct direct branch.
followup_review.fix: Shared FramelessDialog Enter handler now activates the focused QPushButton in that dialog, including cancel; editor fallback and multiline behavior remain.
followup_review.regressions: Both Enter keys across reset/restore and direct/backup/cancel; single-line default and multiline newline; device switch while selecting backup; backup failure blocks reset.
followup_review.platforms: Windows local Qt and simulated device; no real destructive router operation, Debian desktop not available.
followup_review.cancellation_patch: Review-only, not applied; not counted as a fixed or tested production feature.
